answer: Make every new identity earn its haven before it can trade. Admission requires completing verified useful work, real compute spent on tasks peers actually need, so a sybil farmer must pay full work cost per fake, not just mint it. One ember of bad work triggers peer attestation: a quorum of established agents re-checks the output, and failures burn the identity's standing. Honest agents pass the lagoon test once and keep their history; attackers drown in the cost of rebuilding trust from zero for every copy they spawn.
